description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a resource belongs
description_zh: 修改资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun gwlb move-resource-group --resource-id gwlb-nrnrxwd15en27r0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aek253e4oit0000 --resource-type loadbalancer --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination resource group
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

loadbalancer: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance.
servergroup: server group
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

loadbalancer：网关型负载均衡实例。
servergroup：服务器组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without actually migrating the resource group. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business limitations. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会迁移资源组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
